_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be an Indian steel company, team, or individual, as applicable under the award category. > **Eligibility for Company and Team Categories:** > (Applicable for Efficiency Award, Export Award, Sustainability Award, Indigenization Award, Innovation Through Research and Development Award, and Safety Award) 1. The applicant must be an Indian Steel Company or Team, whether a Public Sector Undertaking or a Private Sector. 1. The applicant must fall under one of the following production categories based on crude steel production capacity: - Large Scale Producers: Production capacity greater than 1 Million Tonnes Per Annum. - Secondary Steel Producers: Production capacity less than 1 Million Tonnes Per Annum. > **Exceptional Contribution Award:** 1. The applicant must be a citizen of India. 1. The applicant must possess a Bachelor’s degree in Metallurgical Engineering, Materials Science, or equivalent qualification. 1. The applicant must have made an exceptional and transformative contribution to the Indian steel sector. 1. The contribution may include pioneering research, technological development, policy advocacy, industry leadership, or lifetime service. 1. The contribution must have a demonstrable impact in the past 10 years. 1. The applicant's age must be 25-60 years.
